stem: Who was the founder of the Karnata dynasty?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Nanyadeva (1097–1147 CE) was the founder of the Karnat dynasty. He was a great warrior. Nanyadeva established Simraongarh as the capital of the Karnats. The rule of the Karnat dynasty (1097–1325 CE) is called the “Golden Age of Mithila.”

stem: Who was the last king of the Karnata dynasty?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The last ruler of the Karnat dynasty was Harisimha Deva. He was a patron of art and literature. He initiated the registration system.

stem:
Consider the following statements regarding the Vikramshila University in Bihar :
1. It was located in the present-day Banka district of Bihar.
2. It was established by King Gopala I of the Pala dynasty.
3. The ‘Vajrayana’ sect of Buddhism flourished here.
4. Other subjects like Astronomy, Logic, Law, Grammar and Philosophy were also taught here.
Which of the above statements are incorrect ?
expl: Vikramshila University (Mahavihara) was founded by the Pala ruler Dharmapala. It was located in the present-day Bhagalpur district of Bihar. Vajrayana, the Tantric branch of Buddhism, had the greatest influence in this university. Besides this, other subjects such as astronomy, logic, law, grammar and philosophy were also taught here. At the end of the 12th century, this university was destroyed by the army of Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khilji.

stem: Which ruler of Bengal founded the ancient University called ‘Vikramshila.’
expl: The ancient Buddhist university of Vikramshila was founded by Dharmapala (770–810 CE), a Pala ruler of Bengal. According to the Tibetan scholar Lama Taranatha, by the 10th century, Vikramshila had become an even larger center of learning than Nalanda University.

stem: The Maithili language was started to develop during the reign of which of the following?
expl: The development of the Maithili language began during the rule of the Karnat dynasty (11th to 14th centuries CE). The founder of the Karnat dynasty was Nanyadeva.

stem: ‘Odantapura’ educational center was located in which state?

options.label: e
options.text: None of these/More than one of the above

expl: ‘Odantapura’, also called Uddandpura, was a major educational center in ancient times. It was located in the state of Bihar. It was founded by Gopala, the first ruler of the Pala dynasty.

stem: Which Sultan was reputed to be 'Akbar of Kashmir'?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Due to his religious tolerance and social reforms, Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin is called the “Akbar of Kashmir.” He had many important Sanskrit texts translated and patronized physicians such as Shri Bhatt and Mansur bin Ahmad.
